name: reinforced-computer-use
description: Windows-first bounded Computer Use loops with a local deterministic fast path, optional Jev decisions, safety handoffs, and independent verification.

interface.shortDescription: Windows 多步骤界面操作的安全快速执行层
interface.longDescription: Codex 负责目标、权限和最终验收；本插件在一次 Computer Use 调用中执行已知步骤，或让可选 Jev 决策器从严格白名单动作中选择下一步。所有动作都会重新观察、校验目标，并在高风险控件前交还 Codex。
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Reinforced Computer Use to complete this Windows UI workflow with a bounded fast loop and independently verify the result.
